description: Frontier Desk's guides: one page per question an owner asks before a sale, a loan or a data licence. Each row carries the question the guide answers, a forty-to-sixty-word answer to it, the day the guide was last updated, and its address. Pass a slug from here to get_guide for the whole guide. Newest first.

query.description: Words to find in a guide's title, question or description, for example "MSP" or "data room".

title: List the desk's guides
